searchText: Revisiting the topic of BAL retention period. Have there been updates recently? I know geth has been fine (not pruning), and besu, or nethermind(?), extended their windows. Would be great to have each client team double check their BAL pruning. Relevant PR (<@586161934425128960> ): https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12347 <@&1460290804898861117> Context is, CL clients want to blind BALs for deduplication. For that, they need to be able to reconstruct non-blinded payload envelopes, and for that they need the EL to be able to deliver those objects. CLs may reduce that period in the future, but not for glam, which makes those changes necessary.

excerpts.author: nero_eth
excerpts.content:
Context is, CL clients want to blind BALs for deduplication.
For that, they need to be able to reconstruct non-blinded payload envelopes, and for that they need the EL to be able to deliver those objects.
CLs may reduce that period in the future, but not for glam, which makes those changes necessary.
